A man, a plan, a canal: Panama was the name of a ship that sailed from Europe to Asia and back in the late 19th century. In the time it took to travel this route, many people would watch the stars and dream of adventures far beyond their own lives. But now, as we look up at the night sky, we are reminded of how transient our existence truly is. The universe is vast and full of wonders that we can only begin to imagine, but one thing remains certain: no matter where we go or what we do, our love for each other will always be the greatest adventure of all. A man, a plan, a canal: Panama.
